Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(csp\): allow CDN in connect-src and stop SW intercepting cross-origin requests

The Service Worker''s fetch\(\) calls are governed by connect-src \(not script-src\),
so NoSleep.js CDN was being blocked despite script-src allowing it. Also stopped
SW from proxying cross-origin requests which caused cascading fetch failures.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

EOF
\)")
